content.short: T3tris Finance lets managers deploy and operate async ERC-4626 vaults on any EVM chain.
content.description: T3tris Finance is infrastructure for deploying, curating and operating asynchronous ERC-4626 vaults on any EVM chain, where deposits and withdrawals settle on a delay and not instantly. That delay is deliberate: it lets a vault use execution models that cannot settle synchronously, including CEX, RWA, OTC, cross-chain, options, staking and epoch-based strategies. Curators pay no protocol fees, because T3tris instead earns on idle capital during the settlement window by routing it to a money market. Depositors receive shares that track the strategy's performance net of the curator's own fees.
content.meta: Asynchronous ERC-4626 vaults, letting strategies hold positions that cannot unwind on demand.
